newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish May consumer confidence falls to 15.5 pts.
newsitem.headline: Finnish May consumer confidence falls to 15.5 pts.

text.p: Finnish consumer confidence fell in May to 15.5 points from a record high of 17.1 points in April, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Thursday.
"Over half of Finns estimated that the country's economy has improved during the past year. Every other (Finn) believed it would also improve during the next year," SF said.
It said the same in the April report.

Consumer confidence is measured as the average of estimates on five variables: personal finances in the past year and coming year, the Finnish economy in the past and the coming year, and how advantageous it is to buy durable goods.
The consumer confidence indicator was 17.1 points in April, 15.6 points in March, 15.9 points in February and 15.5 points in January and 13.8 points in December.
